summary_1line: Sanjaya prepares to depart while Yudhishthira sends respectful greetings and inquiries to elders and figures in the Kuru court despite looming conflict.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sanjaya stands before Yudhishthira and the Pandava brothers in their camp, hands folded in farewell as the warriors listen solemnly.
Yudhishthira seated calmly among the Pandavas instructs Sanjaya to bow and inquire after the welfare of Bhishma, Drona, and the elders of the Kuru court.
